CURRENT QUESTION:
average shuttle run improvement or decline per location, endline minus baseline
attempts.response:
WITH baseline AS (
  SELECT "Location", "Shuttle Run sec" AS baseline_time
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
),
endline AS (
  SELECT "Location", "Shuttle Run sec" AS endline_time
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    b."Location",
    e.endline_time - b.baseline_time AS improvement
  FROM baseline b
  JOIN endline e ON b."Location" = e."Location"
)
SELECT 
  "Location",
  AVG(improvement) AS avg_improvement
FROM combined
GROUP BY "Location"
ORDER BY "Location";
